subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about reactivating lapsed-trial and cancelled-paid users for {Brand}, the way we did for AI writing tools like Jasper and Copy.ai. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to a validated reactivation that renews at least once, with App Store Server Notifications and Play RTDN read server-side so you only pay against refund-adjusted resumed subscriptions. Illustratively that lands around a 34% trial-to-paid on the recovered cohort. Want me to send the trial-to-paid recovery view?
illustrative_flags: trial-to-paid conversion of 34% on the recovered cohort (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN ai_tool retargeting: references prior outreach in first sentence (Jasper/Copy.ai win-back); restates single proof (validated server-side reactivation that renews, refund-adjusted); one illustrative MobUpps figure (34% trial-to-paid), flagged, not stated as fact; reuses only parent brands; soft CTA, 1 question mark; native EN; no sign-off; no em-dash; no X-not-Y (states the positive).
